stories.title: Ministers can’t control gas prices, but they can attack other energy costs more ruthlessly
summary: Louise Haigh talked the right talk at the CBI this week, but greater ambition and tighter timelines are neededShocked by average annual energy bills at £2,166 for the first three months of next year?

It is currently possible, and perhaps even likely, that the regulator, Ofgem, will set the price cap at £2,000-plus in every quarter of 2027.Predictions for bills are less certain the further out one looks, it should be said.
Gas prices, the overwhelming culprit in the £443 hike in the cap announced on Wednesday, can always fall – and might do so if calm returns to the strait of Hormuz.
